summary: The final detailed design meeting discussed the look and feel design, user interface design, and evaluated the product, resulting in a final decision on the remote control's details. The Ninja Homo design includes an LCD screen, scroll wheel, number pad, confirm button, power button, and jog dial. The design aims for a stylish look and feel, high-tech innovation, and simplicity of use. The team rated the design's stylish look and feel as 5 or 6 out of 7 and high-tech innovation as 2 to 3 out of 7. The design achieved 70% efficacy of the original goal. The remote control design features a snowman shape, no LCD display, kinetic power and battery, rubber buttons, backlighting with internal LEDs, a jog dial, and the company slogan. The dimensions are 10 centimeters in height. The features include a jog dial for volume, contrast, brightness, channel tuning, and input selection. The remote control will have a battery, but no kinetic power, due to cost restraints. The case will be single, not double, and may not have rubber buttons due to cost. The interface will have a limited number of buttons, with four being a potential number.
